features.title: Run trusted project checks
features.summary: Run configured fixed-argv actions only inside canonical trusted project roots and retain bounded receipts without exposing child output.

configuration.constraints: At most 32 unique actions; each id is lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens and 1 to 32 characters.
One fixed executable string, 1 to 2048 characters; never interpreted by a shell.
At most 64 argv strings, each at most 2048 characters.
Absolute canonical project root, 1 to 2048 characters.
Boolean; enable turn-stopping verification before completion.

failureModes: A sibling or traversal path is rejected before spawn.
Subprocess timeout, cancellation, or storage failure yields a bounded failure receipt.

externalDependencies.boundary: Host-managed child process execution within the configured root.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Use a fake subprocess provider with a temporary project root and harmless argv; never run commands in a user project.

verification.testName: requires absolute trusted roots and unique action ids
trims old receipts per session while preserving the newest rows
allows a session directory under its trusted root and rejects sibling traversal
marks check receipts stale when the working-copy revision changes
bounds completion feedback and names the attempt limit

features.title: Show native hook invocation records
features.summary: Display actual hook invoked/result events and avoid inventing skipped-hook records that DSH does not provide.
failureModes: A missing native event remains not-reported rather than being inferred as skipped.

verification.reason: Hook records come from a hook bridge such as @deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code, which is not a dependency of the web profile the e2e scratch profile is composed from, so a patched bridge row cannot resolve there and no hook/invoked or hook/result event is ever written; the panel's reading of those events is covered by the unit test listed here.

verification.testName: accepts fractional durations recorded by the native Hook Protocol

features.title: Project check receipts appear safely in the Activity Timeline
features.summary: Persist authoritative verification receipts before emitting a strict v1 safe summary, replay a bounded recent window when Activity Timeline starts, and keep Project Checks useful when Timeline is absent.
failureModes: A timeline ingestion failure cannot fail a check after its receipt is durable.
A legacy receipt without revision fields remains readable and backfillable.
Backfill is bounded to retained receipts and repeated delivery converges by receipt id.
Current source freshness is recalculated by the Project Checks API; configuration equivalence remains unknown.

externalDependencies.boundary: Optional versioned Activity event projection and backfill trigger; Project Checks owns receipt storage and never requires Timeline availability.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Exercise the callback ordering, strict summary, legacy records, bounded replay, and timeline-absent scratch composition.

verification.testName: publishes only the bounded, versioned receipt facts
waits for durable receipt persistence before publishing and keeps projection failures optional
reads legacy receipts and bounds newer-first backfill to retained evidence
